pages.text: Four Watchers keep the firmament: $(l)Solenne$() of the sun, $(l)Vael$() of the moon, $(l)Orrin$() the starsmith, and I, $(l)Ilyra$(), who writes it all down.$(br2)There was a fifth. We do not speak the name. We call it the $(l)Eclipse$().

A rift has opened in the sky. Through it, fragments of the firmament fall to your world – and through it, the Eclipse stirs.$(br2)You have looked up. That makes you a $(l)Seeker$(). Whether you become more is up to you.
